title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - proposed acquisition of Australian waste management business of Thiess Services Pty Ltd
targets: Australian waste management business of Thiess Services Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.

ACCC requested further information from the parties. ACCC timeline suspended. Former proposed decision date of 19 July 2012 delayed pending receipt of further information from the merger parties. A new indicative decision date will be announced in due course.
The proposed acquisition is no longer proceeding. Consequently, the ACCC has discontinued its review without making a final decision. The former proposed decision date of the review was 19 July 2012.
